a sst. crohan’s church, caherdaniel; chtwey & mary immact month of prayer for vocations to the priesthood untying the rope: the courage to begin . throughout october, our diocese is dedicating a month to prayer for vocations to the diocesan priesthood in kerry. each week invites us to reflect on a different aspect of the journey. this week, our theme is “setting sail” — a special invitation to those who may be discerning god's call to the priesthood. our thoughts turn naturally to st brendan the navigator, our great kerry saint, who reminds us that every journey begins with a willingness to leave the familiar behind. brendan did not remain on the shore, waiting until every uncertainty had been resolved. he untied the rope, set sail and entrusted himself to god. there is something deeply meaningful in that image for anyone discerning a vocation. it can be tempting to wait until we have all the answers, until the whole journey is mapped out, or until we feel completely ready. yet god rarely reveals the entire voyage at once. he invites us to trust him enough to take the next faithful step. is god calling you? an invitation to men in our parish and throughout south kerry if you have ever wondered whether god might be calling you to the diocesan priesthood, please do not be afraid to take that first step. reach out to fr sean or your local priest. you will be met with understanding, encouragement and every support as you explore what god may be asking of you. there is no need to have everything figured out before beginning the conversation. discerning is a journey, and you do not have to make it alone. you may be surprised by where that first conversation leads. all that is asked at the beginning is a willing heart and the courage to listen.
